title: Simplify CLI distribution and usage
description: Make the local CLI easier for a fresh user to install, configure, and run after the distribution plan in loreweaver-0m5. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r. Scope should evaluate reducing required manual steps such as building from source, setting LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH before first run, invoking node packages/cli/dist/index.js directly, and manually discovering Dolt/checkpoint setup. Coordinate with loreweaver-ygm for default app-data locations.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-user path is implemented or documented that uses a simple loreweaver command after install; README getting-started instructions are updated; required configuration is minimized or clearly prompted; package/install smoke tests cover the chosen path; any remaining non-obvious setup is filed as follow-up beads.
close_reason: Simplified documented CLI usage around npm install -g and the loreweaver command; improved config guidance; tightened package metadata and added package smoke coverage; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Verification: npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm run test -> exit 0 with 35 test files passed / 1 skipped and 213 tests passed / 1 skipped. Acceptance: README now leads fresh users to npm install -g @loreweaver/cli and the simple loreweaver/loreweaver play commands; CLI config errors print LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and next command guidance; package files/engines metadata added; package smoke covers npm pack --dry-run contents for core and CLI. Filed loreweaver-v1w for the remaining clean-prefix global-install release workflow smoke.
